verdict.rationale: Transactional evidence implies a suppression mechanism: it has a rejection denylist whose entries are cleared when an address is allowlisted, and its webhooks report hard-bounce, spam, unsub and reject events. One community report also says Mailchimp removed contacts over spam complaints, which suggests some automatic list cleaning on the marketing side. Missing for 10: explicit docs that unsubscribes, bounces and complaints are suppressed automatically by default; evidence that suppression is shared across Marketing and Transactional sends; CAN-SPAM/GDPR compliance documentation; independent hands-on corroboration.
